free_tier.stated: Cloud VPS TOT K from VND 67,500/month on the vendor's home page (the page's 'chi tu 67.500 VND/thang' entry for the TOT K line). The plan shapes are the tracker's: USD 3.00/month for 1 Intel core, 512 MB RAM, 8 GB SSD, 31,641 GB/month bandwidth on a 0.1 Gbps port; the vendor's TOT K line is sold in Ha Noi (VNPT or CMC) or Ho Chi Minh City (FPT), and the tracker's row is Ho Chi Minh. The TOT K plan table did not render to text, so the specs at VND 67,500 are not first-party here.
